name: one-c-erp-diagnostics
description: Dynamic evidence-first orchestration and a verified companion ecosystem for 1C:ERP diagnostics, code analysis and controlled remediation.

interface.longDescription: A single dynamic entrypoint for 1C:ERP incidents. It discovers actual capabilities, builds a bounded evidence graph, routes 32 packaged specialist skills, coordinates verified companion plugins and optional local SonarQube BSL analysis when available, enforces artifact lineage, execution identity, exact synthetic capability snapshots, inventory-only, stale-execution and under-evidenced exact output semantics plus scoped machine-readable evaluation contracts, challenges conclusions adversarially, and controls proposed actions through reversible R0–R3 risk gates.
defaultPrompt: Сравни корректный и проблемный примеры 1С:ERP и перепроверь причину.
Покажи доступные 1С-навыки и построй безопасный план анализа.
